name: io.github.Cloto-dev/cpersona
title: CPersona
description: Persistent memory for AI agents in one SQLite file: hybrid vector + full-text + keyword search, no LLM in the loop, honest about degraded recall.

environmentVariables.name: CPERSONA_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: SQLite database path. Defaults to data/cpersona.db, which follows the client's working directory — set it to an absolute path to keep one memory across sessions.

environmentVariables.name: CPERSONA_EMBEDDING_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Embedding mode: 'http' to use an embedding server for vector search, 'none' for lexical layers only.

environmentVariables.name: CPERSONA_EMBEDDING_URL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding server endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8401/embed. Required when CPERSONA_EMBEDDING_MODE=http.

environmentVariables.name: CPERSONA_UPDATE_CHECK
environmentVariables.description: Check the package index once per process start for a newer (or withdrawn) release and report it through recall / check_health / check_update. Set to false for no outbound request at all. Updating is never automatic.
